formal_specification.domain: Partial contract only: rank admission for table constructors, cyclic-ring constructor and SU2 level. Other ring operations remain unreviewed.
behavior: Admit exactly 1..=32 with no allocation, returning RankOutOfRange otherwise. This new common guard precedes convenience constructor allocations.
Admit rank before allocating default name strings; pass names and multiplicities to with_names. Invalid-rank requests allocate no constructor-owned heap storage.
Admit rank first, then exactly rank cubed multiplicities, then exactly rank names; own a raw shaped table. This constructor alone does not validate fusion-ring laws.
Admit const R before flattening the caller-supplied stack array; preserve the original row-major order and ordinary constructor behavior on admitted R.
Admit the cyclic modulus via pointed/AbelianGroup before generating names; preserve accepted default names for n=2..32 and legacy refusal of n=0,1.

checked_add the level-plus-one rank; return typed Overflow for usize::MAX, preserve the zero-level/rank error and admit levels 1..31 before allocation. For admitted i,j<=k, i+j<=2*k proves the high-limit subtraction exact without saturation.

admit_rank.obligation: Admit exactly 1..=32 with no allocation, returning RankOutOfRange otherwise. This new common guard precedes convenience constructor allocations.

FusionTable::new.obligation: Admit rank before allocating default name strings; pass names and multiplicities to with_names. Invalid-rank requests allocate no constructor-owned heap storage.

FusionTable::with_names.obligation: Admit rank first, then exactly rank cubed multiplicities, then exactly rank names; own a raw shaped table. This constructor alone does not validate fusion-ring laws.

FusionTable::from_array.obligation: Admit const R before flattening the caller-supplied stack array; preserve the original row-major order and ordinary constructor behavior on admitted R.

FusionRing::z_n.obligation: Admit the cyclic modulus via pointed/AbelianGroup before generating names; preserve accepted default names for n=2..32 and legacy refusal of n=0,1.

FusionRing::su2_level.obligation: checked_add the level-plus-one rank; return typed Overflow for usize::MAX, preserve the zero-level/rank error and admit levels 1..31 before allocation. For admitted i,j<=k, i+j<=2*k proves the high-limit subtraction exact without saturation.

invariants: For rank r in 1..32, r cubed<=32768, so table sizes and flattened indices are bounded before construction. The new guard itself is allocation-free and reaches every convenience path before its allocations. Caller-provided names, multiplicity vectors and arrays already exist and are outside this constructor-owned allocation claim.

For SU2 accepted k<=31 and rank=k+1, all i,j<=k imply i+j<=2*k; direct natural subtraction is exact and all intermediate usize products fit the compiled platform. The pre-admission k+1 has an explicit overflow error instead of a panic or wrap.

failure_paths.rank: Reject invalid rank before owned name/flat allocation.
failure_paths.level: checked_add failure is typed Overflow; zero/excessive levels refuse before allocation.

formal_specification.domain: Any finite slice of raw Ratio<i64> values and raw Ratio<i64> total. Every used denominator must be nonzero. Negative entries and cancellation remain admitted; acceptance concerns only the aggregate, not physical simple-object dimensions.
behavior: Reject a zero total denominator before constructing a rational. Lift signed numerator and denominator separately to BigInt and normalize exactly in BigRational.
Reject a nonpositive exact total. Otherwise accumulate each ratio in BigRational, rejecting any zero entry denominator before its rational construction.
Return true exactly for a well-formed list whose exact sum equals the strictly positive total. No i64 arithmetic is used to combine values, and no saturation or floating-point rounding occurs.
The public signature and boolean refusal style are preserved. Individual negative entries may participate in a positive sum; no per-entry physical dimension validation is claimed.

verify_fusion_global_dimension.obligation: Exact rational aggregate equals the strictly positive total, with every used denominator nonzero; preserve signed cancellation, refuse malformed inputs, use arbitrary-precision arithmetic.

invariants: A nonzero signed i64 denominator/numerator pair embeds exactly into arbitrary integers then into their normalized rational quotient, including i64::MIN and negative denominators. By induction over the list, each successful sum prefix equals its mathematical rational sum; large cancellation cannot overflow fixed-width storage.

The sum predicate has finite O(N) rational additions, but operand bit lengths grow with the rational input; no constant memory/time or whole-fusion-law guarantee is claimed. Compiler, num_bigint/num_rational, allocator and external path dependencies remain TCB.

failure_paths.aggregate: Return false for malformed used denominators, nonpositive total or unequal exact sum; caller inputs remain borrowed/unchanged.
